mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 70 degrees with foggy conditions near the Verona Public Library, though it feels more like 76 degrees. We are currently under a Waning Gibbous moon.

City officials have announced that the Verona Senior Center will undergo a flooring replacement project starting September 1, resulting in limited services and closures through September 11. Also, crews are currently managing a water main break near 212 Todd Street, which has caused a temporary loss of water service for some neighborhood properties.

Today, you can join the fun at Hop Haus Trivia or Quizmasters Trivia at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking toward tomorrow, the schedule includes the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
In a notable call from August 25, officers responded to a medical emergency on Enterprise Drive where they successfully used an AED to assist a patient, who then regained a pulse.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM, so you have plenty of time to head out and enjoy a treat.
